hypothesis: Among new Wine true trajectories event-free at update5 and geometrically eligible at the fixed radius, the upper10% of early X has future sampled GEOMETRIC_NONINJECTIVITY precision at least3 times the cohort incidence, with positive cluster-CI lower bound for precision minus incidence.
historical_design: Supersedes only the unexecuted same-state T2 design prospectively; preserves it unchanged as a hashed antecedent. No temporal claim from radius growth within one state.

population.random_cohort: not scheduled; optional later requires separate preregistration

time.early_definition: 5/250=2% of fixed update budget; independent of accuracy and scores
time.weights_at_zero: archive for replay only, not alternative predictor
time.stop_rule: continue to250 regardless of accuracy; stop only technical failure, no score- or event-based optional stopping

training.optimizer: original Adam lr0.006, batch64; original initializer/minibatch generator and data split/preprocessing
training.change_from_C1: Replace accuracy>=.99 stopping rule with fixed250 update schedule for this NEW longitudinal experiment only. Never alter old C1. All other update mechanics unchanged; exact first5-update prefix replay gate <=1e-12 on old seeds before new training.

predictor.name: intrinsic kappa_max(Dexp) at endpoint radius
predictor.summary: pooled maximum across512 launch angles in each of phases0 and half-cell; screening256 each phase
predictor.gates: protocol_T1_B_frozen.json unchanged; no radius shrink, infinity or score imputation

event.positive: GEOMETRIC_NONINJECTIVITY using unchanged T1A/A2 frozen hierarchy, at any scheduled t in25,50,...,250 on own D0.02
event.Y1: at least one confirmed positive at scheduled future checkpoints
event.unresolved: otherwise unknown, never0; later confirmed positive resolves Y1 even if another visit was unknown, but missing/failed required audits still block full technical PASS
event.scope: sampled-visit cumulative incidence, not continuous-time guarantee; transient events between visits may be missed
event.followup: begins strictly after update5, first assessed25; ends250

eligibility.baseline: all800 audited at5 before future training; nominal INJECTIVE_AT_NOMINAL_RADIUS required
eligibility.prevalent_positive: document as baseline prevalent, exclude from incident-risk estimand, never replace
eligibility.geometrically_invalid_rstar: exclude only with documented stable geometric invalidity under inherited audit independent of numeric score; preserve counts and coverage
eligibility.numerical_failure: not structural exclusion; any unresolved predictor/baseline/future numerical failure makes primary INCONCLUSIVE, no survivor-only confirmation
eligibility.CA_missing: never impute; failed comparator gates make incremental secondary INCONCLUSIVE; primary unaffected if all primary gates otherwise pass
eligibility.no_event_early_termination: unknown outcome, technical INCONCLUSIVE; do not treat as negative
eligibility.administrative_end: complete negative sequence isY0 at250; right-censored after250 only

tail.size: ceil(.1*Neligible); include all exact ties at cutoff
tail.freeze: score table, eligibility list and cutoff SHA before training beyond5 or opening future outcomes
tail.tie_gate: actual tail above15% => INCONCLUSIVE; no arbitrary tie break

comparators.domains: own admissible D0.02, six-source B7/B8 protocol unchanged

formulas.Lambda_q: fraction of integrated K^2 in highest-K^2 area fraction q; area-weighted fractional-cell interpolation

comparators.zero_energy: retain inherited definition; undefined remains missing, no new epsilon
comparators.cost: measure standalone and shared-cache marginal CPU/wall separately, same hardware/thread limits; do not assume CA is cheaper

primary_statistics.unit: one binary future outcome per trajectory; trajectories nested in split with distinct initialization seeds
primary_statistics.CI: two-sided95% percentile cluster bootstrap,20000 draws of entire splits with replacement; retain all trajectories/visits; rerankX and apply frozenq incl ties within each draw
success: precision-base>0 after leaving any one split out and reranking using sameq
primary_statistics.FAIL: all technical/information gates pass but any effect/CI/stability criterion fails; not proof of no association
primary_statistics.INCONCLUSIVE: technical/coverage/event/positive-split/tie/CI-degeneracy gate fails; budget interruption also inconclusive
primary_statistics.scope: prospective conditional fixed-Wine pilot support; not independent-dataset/general-law/causal confirmation

secondary.PR_AUC: average precision, noninterpolated step sum DeltaRecall*Precision with score ties pooled; no trapezoidal variant
other: precision and event incidence per split
same-time comparator tails and paired bootstrap differences
secondary.incremental_utility: descriptive only: require precision_X - precision_each comparator >=.05 AND standalone CPU_X/min(CPU_comparators)<=2; all3 comparator families complete; no change to primarydecision
secondary.residuals: exploratory only; no confirmatory reuse of T1B residual pattern
secondary.multiplicity: one primarydecision only; secondary95% intervals labeled descriptive, no secondary claim rescues primary

power.method: exact binomial event counts; convolution160(or128) beta-binomial blocks ofsize5; exact two-binomial optimistic benchmark for lifts1,2,3,5; no claim of full-design80% power
power.note: 2/80 prior endpoint frequency is not temporal incidence nor true-specific estimate; scenarios are assumptions not fitted forecasts

external_T2B: different task and/or architecture; freeze dataset, metric scale mapping, predictor time, sampling and gates in a separate preregistration before inspecting external states; never assume numerical rstar transfers.
prohibitions: no threshold or timing tuning on new outcomes
